analysis: The 6_3 screw operation constrains axial three-phonon couplings through a wave-vector-dependent representation condition. A screw-eigenmode basis resolves degenerate subspaces before the interaction strengths are grouped by character sector. The selected normal and odd-axial-Umklapp triplets show different strength distributions in the three supplied force models. The reported sector shares and effective counts are properties of these models, processes, and mesh; they do not by themselves quantify a bulk thermal-conductivity effect.
